notes: Access-control enforcement is intentionally broken: CORS allows everything, an authorization middleware on product modification is commented out, and directory/file listing is exposed. Access to resources is not reliably restricted to authorised entities.

evidence.detail: PUT /api/Products authorization intentionally commented out (changeProductChallenge).
app.use(cors()) allows all origins per the 'Allow everything!' comment.
Public /ftp directory listing and file download exposed.

notes: No evidence of segregation of duties between development/operation or between authorisers/controllers. CONTRIBUTING.md describes a PR/branch workflow only, not personnel segregation.

evidence.detail: Only a branch/PR contribution model is documented; no segregation-of-duties evidence.

notes: Roles exist but least-privilege and periodic access review are not implemented; privilege escalation and broken access control are intentional challenges, and some destructive endpoints deny all while others are deliberately left open.

evidence.detail: PUT/DELETE /api/Users/:id denyAll, yet other endpoints are intentionally unguarded.
Role whitelist exists but access rights are not enforced per least privilege.

notes: External authentication is intentionally weak: login uses string-concatenated SQL, a default weak admin credential (admin123) is a known challenge, and rate limiting is applied only to reset-password, not login (no attempt limiting/lockout).

evidence.detail: Login builds SQL by string concatenation (SQLi / loginAdmin challenge).
Known weak admin credential admin123 is a challenge trigger.
Rate limiting only on /rest/user/reset-password; no login attempt limiting.

notes: Organisation-user authentication lacks credential lifecycle controls: weak/default passwords are intentional challenges, no rotation policy exists, and lockout/attempt-limiting for internal users is absent.

evidence.detail: Password stored via security.hash but weak-password challenge is intentional.
Internal login shares the same weak SQL-concatenated authentication path.
